literal: By the good path having sought, possess compassion; even if examined by many paths, that indeed is the support.
translation: Seek the good path and cherish compassion; for, even if one examines various ways, that alone is the ultimate support.
modern: நல்ல வழியை ஆராய்ந்து கண்டு பிடித்து அருளைக் கடைப்பிடிக்க வேண்டும்; பல வழிகளில் ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தாலும், அந்த அருளே நமக்குச் சிறந்த துணையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme importance of compassion as the ultimate virtue. The poet advises us to seek the right path of life and practice compassion actively. Even if we analyze and evaluate various philosophical, moral, or practical paths to find what is best, we will ultimately conclude that compassion is the only true and lasting support for human life. The word 'நல்லாற்றாள்' (by the good path) guides us to the starting point, while 'துணை' (support) highlights how compassion serves as our protector and companion.
